title: List answer
description: The answer of the command list, on standard output: the machines at the vendor that the adapter made for the request's node pool. The answer is at most 1 MiB. It has no version. The provisioner ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless the must_understand of the answer lists it. A writer marks a member that the provisioner must read, such as version, by listing its pointer in must_understand. The provisioner refuses an answer that lists a pointer it does not define, as a failure of kind defect.

machines.description: The machines of the node pool, empty when the node pool has none. A machine that no longer exists at the vendor is not listed.

id.description: The vendor's id of the machine.

dispatch_id.description: The dispatch the machine was made for, the dispatch_id of its make request.

state.description: The machine's state at the vendor. starting: the vendor is starting the machine. running: the machine runs. stopped: the machine stopped and still exists. deleting: the vendor is deleting the machine.

started.description: When the vendor started the machine, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds.

must_understand.description: The members of the document that the reader must understand, each as a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) counted from the document, such as /machines. List each once, at most 32. A pointer has no line feed, and writes ~ only as ~0 or ~1. Each pointer is to a member that this schema defines. A writer lists a member that the reader must read, such as /version. The provisioner ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless must_understand lists it. It refuses an answer whose must_understand lists a pointer that it does not define, as a failure of kind defect.
